title: A Prom for the Playlist
premise: Freya Thornbury, a trans boy hiding behind an anonymous coding account that exposes his elite prep school's secrets, counts the days to graduation while keeping everyone at arm's length. When he finds coded instructions in his late grandmother's recipe box—directions to a hidden archive proving the school's founding family stole land and erased a community—he realizes his grandmother was the anonymous whistleblower before him, and the account's password is buried in her cipher. As prom approaches and his best friend Priya gets dangerously close to unmasking him, Freya must choose between publishing the truth and protecting the people he loves, knowing the headmaster will destroy anyone who leaks it. In the end, he comes out—to his friend, his school, and the world—at prom itself, releasing the archive as the playlist hits its final song.
about_author: Dominic Blackwood is a former software engineer who traded debugging production servers for drafting small-town secrets and big-hearted rebels. He writes young adult fiction from a cluttered desk overlooking the Pacific Northwest rain, fueled by cold coffee and old mixtapes.

chapters.title: Countdown in Binary
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Opening days of senior spring at Ashford Prep; Freya runs the anonymous exposé account @thornwatch between classes, counting down to graduation like a prison sentence. He deflects Priya's attempts to plan prom together. Emotional beat: weary isolation, the comfort of anonymity.

chapters.title: The Recipe Box
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Sorting his grandmother's belongings, Freya finds a recipe box where several cards hold no food—instead, strings of numbers and a note: 'For whoever is brave enough.' He recognizes fragments of his own encryption style. Emotional beat: eerie recognition, grief sharpening into curiosity.

chapters.title: Priya Knows Something
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya notices Freya's distraction and his browser history of archival scans; she's also been assigned by student council to investigate @thornwatch before prom, since the account threatened to 'drop everything' that night. Emotional beat: loyalty pulling against duty.

chapters.title: Cipher Kitchen
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Late nights decoding the recipe cards using cooking terms as keys—'fold in gently,' 'let rest.' He cracks the first layer: coordinates to a locked basement in the town library and the phrase 'the orchard was never empty.' Emotional beat: thrill of discovery tinged with dread.

chapters.title: Headmaster Vale's Invitation
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Headmaster Vale summons Freya—not about the account, but offering him a legacy scholarship and a seat on the 'founding families' committee, a velvet bribe. Freya accepts with a smile while his skin crawls. Emotional beat: the seduction of belonging versus suspicion.

chapters.title: The Basement Archive
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Using the decoded key, Freya enters the library basement and finds his grandmother's hidden archive: deeds, photographs, and testimony showing the school's founding family seized the orchard land from a Black farming community—and that his grandmother documented it all before dying. Emotional beat: awe curdling into fury.

chapters.title: What Grandma Buried
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya, researching @thornwatch's posting patterns, narrows suspects to a handful of seniors—including, uncomfortably, Freya. Meanwhile she uncovers her own family's connection to the displaced orchard community. Emotional beat: the personal becoming political.

chapters.title: Prom Court Politics
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Prom nominations go up; Vale quietly engineers Freya onto the court to keep him visible and grateful. Freya's name is read aloud with his deadname by accident—or not. Emotional beat: public humiliation masked as honor; rage he must swallow.

chapters.title: Two Truths
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya confronts Freya gently about the deadname incident and catches him lying about where he was Tuesday nights. She shows him her great-grandmother's name in one of the scanned photos he accidentally left open. Emotional beat: the friendship cracking under the weight of secrets.

chapters.title: The Leak Hunt
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Vale launches an investigation into @thornwatch, hiring a private firm to trace the account. Freya scrubs his tracks but realizes the account's original password hint matches the recipe box cipher—the account was always his grandmother's. Emotional beat: vertigo; he inherited a war.

chapters.title: Deadline: Graduation Day
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Decoding the final card reveals a scheduled auto-post: if @thornwatch doesn't publish the full archive by graduation day, everything self-deletes forever. His grandmother built a failsafe—and a deadline. Emotional beat: terror and resolve entwined.

chapters.title: Bargaining with Vale
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Vale, suspecting Freya, offers him everything—college money, a clean record, protection—in exchange for handing over 'whatever your grandmother left you.' Freya realizes Vale has known about the archive all along. Emotional beat: power's corruption laid bare; fear turning to contempt.

chapters.title: Priya's Ultimatum
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya tells Freya she knows he's @thornwatch and demands the truth—all of it, including why he flinches at his own name. He gives her half. She walks away hurt. Emotional beat: heartbreak as the cost of half-truths.

chapters.title: The Orchard Walk
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Freya visits the overgrown orchard from the photographs and finds descendants of the displaced families still living nearby, including an elderly woman who remembers his grandmother. They give him the missing testimony pages. Emotional beat: inheritance redefined—grief becoming purpose.

chapters.title: Compromised
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. The private investigators trace a login to the school library during Freya's free period. Vale confronts him privately with the evidence and threatens expulsion and legal action unless the archive surfaces and burns. Emotional beat: cornered; the walls closing in.

chapters.title: Burn Notice
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya learns Vale plans to expel Freya before prom to bury the story quietly. Torn between self-preservation and justice, she copies the archive files Freya stashed in their shared study folder and starts planning something reckless. Emotional beat: courage kindling in anger.

chapters.title: The Playlist
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Prom committee finalizes the night's playlist; Freya smuggles a USB drive into the AV booth, rigging the archive release to trigger mid-song. He writes two messages—one to the school, one to Priya—and can't decide whether to send either. Emotional beat: trembling brinkmanship.

chapters.title: Prom Night, First Dance
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Prom begins in candlelit splendor; Vale patrols like a warden. Priya arrives intending to enjoy one normal night, but when the DJ cues the third song, the gym screens flicker with scanned deeds. Gasps. Vale moves toward the AV booth. Emotional beat: the calm before detonation.

chapters.title: Everything Drops
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. The archive publishes: every deed, photo, and testimony, plus @thornwatch's final post signed with his real name and his truth about who he is. Chaos erupts; Vale cuts the power, but phones are already glowing with screenshots. Freya steps into the light, literally, as students turn. Emotional beat: terror, then unbearable freedom.

chapters.title: Confrontation Under the Disco Ball
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Vale tries to have Freya removed; Priya blocks the doors and reads the orchard families' testimony aloud over the speakers until students join in, chanting names. Faculty who received anonymous tips months ago finally side with the students. Emotional beat: collective defiance; love against duty resolved in solidarity.

chapters.title: Aftermath in the Parking Lot
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Dawn after prom: Vale suspended pending investigation, the board opening a restitution process with the orchard families. Freya and Priya sit on his car hood, exhausted, honest at last—about the account, the archive, and himself. Emotional beat: tender repair; friendship reforged in truth.

chapters.title: Graduation Day
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. At graduation, Freya walks across the stage under his chosen name, announced without hesitation. The orchard community attends as honored guests; a new plaque replaces the founders'. He posts one last time on @thornwatch: 'Signing off. The truth lives here now.' Emotional beat: quiet triumph; identity claimed, duty fulfilled, love secured.
